direct_objdiff_measurements.command: for f in reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_*-session-1350-remediation-1.json; do jq -r '[.left.symbols[0].name,.left.symbols[0].size,.right.symbols[0].size,.left.symbols[0].match_percent,([.left.symbols[0].instructions[]?.instruction.relocation|select(.!=null)]|length),([.right.symbols[0].instructions[]?.instruction.relocation|select(.!=null)]|length)]|@tsv' $f; done; jq -r '["game_data_80239E10",(.left.sections[]|select(.name==".rodata")|.size),(.right.sections[]|select(.name==".rodata")|.size),(.left.symbols[]|select(.name=="[.rodata-0]")|.match_percent)]|@tsv' reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_data_80239E10-session-1350-remediation-1.json
direct_objdiff_measurements.columns: function_or_unit retail_bytes generated_bytes match_percent retail_relocations generated_relocations; the data row omits relocation columns

catalog_validation.schema_command: jq -r '[.lessons[] | select((has("category") and has("functions") and has("precise_divergence") and has("workaround") and has("evidence"))|not)] | "schema_incomplete_lessons=\(length)"' reports/GEDE01/lessons.json
catalog_validation.taxonomy_command: jq -r '[.lessons[].category] as $c | ["calling-convention","float-constant-placement","inlining","instruction-scheduling","jump-table-strategy","register-allocation","stack-slot-reuse"] as $allowed | [$c[] | select(. as $x | ($allowed | index($x)) == null)] | "invalid_lesson_categories=\(length)"' reports/GEDE01/lessons.json
catalog_validation.blocking_findings_command: jq -r '([.lessons[] | select(.category=="float-constant-placement") | .functions[] | select(.=="fn_80186D74")] | length) as $false | ([.lessons[] | select(.category=="instruction-scheduling") | .functions[] | select(.=="fn_80187A4C" or .=="fn_80187E40")] | length) as $force | ([.out_of_taxonomy[] | select(.category=="data-layout" and (.functions|index("game_data_80239E10")))] | length) as $restored | "false_float_citation_count=\($false) force_fit_count=\($force) restored_data_layout_count=\($restored)"' reports/GEDE01/lessons.json
catalog_validation.register_bundle_command: jq -r '[.lessons[] | select(any(.functions[]; .=="fn_80186A88" or .=="fn_80186F70" or .=="fn_80188384" or .=="fn_80189C14" or .=="fn_80189E7C" or .=="fn_8018A060" or .=="fn_8018A1C8")) | select(.category=="register-allocation") | .functions[]] | "remediated_register_allocation_function_records=\(length) unique=\(unique|length)"' reports/GEDE01/lessons.json
